data.name: Pointer Manual
data.detailed_description:
"Pointer Manual"

A mind-bending puzzle game where you take on the role of a mystical unborn pointer from beyond the stars! Guided by a narrator with an absurdly long title, you'll embark on a wildly unpredictable journey here on Earth.

Armed with the seemingly basic powers of cut, copy, and delete, you hold the fate of humanity in your cursor. Every choice you make is like a stone dropped into a lake, sending ripples of chaos or harmony across the world. You can play it safe, solving puzzles and guiding events toward heartwarming, feel-good endings. Or you can throw the rulebook out the window, unleashing chaotic "oopsie-daisy" moves that turn scenarios upside down, and watch as humans react to your shenanigans with hilarious disbelief.

The game’s story is a tangled vine of branching paths—one tiny tweak in your approach can send the narrative spiraling in completely new directions. A single scene might lead to a cozy, wholesome conclusion, a delightfully deranged "nuclear-level chaotic" outcome, or even a hidden dark twist. The number of story paths you can explore is way more than just one or two—every time you restart, you’ll uncover a fresh new way to mess with (or save) the world.

With just a click of your mouse’s left and right buttons, the first-person perspective lets you fully step into the shoes of this world-altering pointer baby. Banter with the chatty narrator as you turn Earth into your very own playground of infinite possibilities, all wrapped in a layer of goofy, lighthearted fun

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: win7
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 or AMD FX 8320
  • Memory: 150 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 or AMD Radeon R9280
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 150 MB available space
